mapper.select: select t.open_id AS openId, u.nickname AS nickname, t.taste_type_id AS tasteTypeId, t.score AS score, t.type_name AS typeName, t.judge_result AS judgeResult from vote_taste_score t, vote_taste_user u where t.taste_id = #{taste_id} and t.open_id = u.openid order by t.open_id, t.taste_type_id;
